text.content:
Dear team,

This is a reminder that the customer-service workshop will take place next Thursday from 9:00 a.m. to noon in Conference Room B. Please arrive [[131]] so that we can begin on time.
The session will cover complaint handling, tone of voice, and follow-up emails. [[132]], each participant will practice a short role-play with a partner.

If you cannot [[133]] the workshop, notify your supervisor by Monday so that your seat can be offered to someone on the waiting list.

[[134]]

Thank you for your cooperation.
Lina Ortega
Learning & Development

questions.explanation: An adverb is needed to modify the verb "arrive." "Promptly" means on time / without delay.
questions.commonMistake: Choosing "prompt" (adjective) because it looks similar; adjectives do not modify verbs.

questions.explanation: The next sentence adds another workshop activity. "In addition" signals an additive relationship.
questions.commonMistake: Picking a contrast connector (Nevertheless / On the contrary) when no contrast is present.

questions.explanation: "Attend" means to be present at an event. The sentence is about not being able to go to the workshop.
questions.commonMistake: Confusing "attend" with "assist" (help) — a common false friend for Spanish speakers.

questions.question: Select the sentence that best fits the blank.

options.text: Printed materials will be available at the registration desk.
The cafeteria menu will change again next month.
Please submit your expense reports before Friday.
Our downtown branch is relocating in October.

questions.correctAnswer: Printed materials will be available at the registration desk.
questions.explanation: Only A continues the workshop logistics (materials for participants). The other options introduce unrelated office topics.
questions.commonMistake: Choosing a grammatical sentence that does not fit the email’s topic (workshop logistics).
